plugins.title: dsh-tunnel
plugins.description: Expose dsh web through the tunnel you choose: Tailscale Funnel, Cloudflare Quick Tunnel, or any custom command. dsh web binds to loopback and its /api fence rejects foreign Host headers, so a bare tunnel answers 403 everywhere; this plugin runs the small reverse proxy that performs the rewrites it needs, then gets out of the way.
